# יאיר סמארט אופיס בע״מ (YAIR SMART OFFICE LTD)

> Company site for Israeli schools and businesses: computing, networks, computer rooms, classroom technology, paging, security cameras, smart learning spaces, and printers. Printer guides are public. There is no account, no form, and no analytics.

## Services

1. IT for schools and businesses — annual service, equipment, and software. https://www.yso.co.il/solutions/it
2. Networks — pedagogical and administrative cabling, cabinets, and fault finding. https://www.yso.co.il/solutions/networks
3. Computer rooms — infrastructure through to the workstation. https://www.yso.co.il/solutions/computer-rooms
4. Classroom technology — display, audio, and teacher connections. https://www.yso.co.il/solutions/classrooms
5. Paging and bells — public address and zone schedules. https://www.yso.co.il/solutions/paging
6. Security cameras and NVR — planning and installation. Access details stay with the client. https://www.yso.co.il/solutions/security
7. Smart learning spaces — turnkey classrooms and shared spaces for elementary schools: planning, drywall niches, power and data, touch screens, computers, and wall art. https://www.yso.co.il/solutions/learning-spaces
8. Printers and copiers — supply, service, and open guides for meter reading and toner replacement. https://www.yso.co.il/solutions/printers

## Smart learning spaces

Based in Ashdod and working across Israel, mainly with elementary schools, municipalities, parent committees, and donors. A single station is typically 3–5 working days. A classroom or shared space is typically two weeks to a month, scheduled in holidays or after the school day. Projects include a one-year warranty and phone or WhatsApp support, and can start as one station. The team also supplies curriculum content packages and supports teacher-made content, including the Ministry of Education Ofek Hadash environment. Installation photos and a before/after comparison are on the learning-spaces page.

## Printer guides

https://www.yso.co.il/guides — search a model, then open the meter or toner guide. No signup. A finished meter reading is sent on WhatsApp with the institution name and the machine number.

## Policies

- Hosted on Vercel. No marketing cookies, no analytics product, and no cookie banner.
- Accessibility settings stay in the browser (localStorage). The splash “already seen” flag stays in sessionStorage. Neither is sent to the server.
- Fonts are served by this site.
- The accessibility statement aims toward Israeli Standard 5568 and WCAG 2.0 AA. It does not claim a completed audit.
- Privacy: https://www.yso.co.il/privacy
- Terms: https://www.yso.co.il/terms
- Accessibility statement: https://www.yso.co.il/accessibility
